hack.root_cause: Unrestricted Collateral Minting in CDP Vault
hack.description: Shezmu's vault accepted collateral anyone could mint for free — an attacker borrowed $4.9M in ShezUSD, then thin liquidity and a 20% bounty deal brought most of it back.
